note:
⛔ SNG-454. ONE ATTUNEMENT REPLACES 32 PERCEIVE-ONLY ABILITIES. Every tradition carried an L1 'first gift' sense at energy 3, magnitude 3, with the identical arc: sense the thing · sense more of it · sense all of it. ⚠️ WHAT DIFFERED WAS THE NOUN, WHICH IS FLAVOUR, NOT A SKILL.
⛔ ATTUNEMENT IS ONE ABILITY WHOSE SECT FLAVOUR IS WHAT YOU PERCEIVE — a Mason reads material, an Ashwarden reads dying, a Horizon-walker reads the way. Same craft, same cost, same ranks, and it stops consuming a slot in every tradition's L1 tier.

abilities.name: Attunement
abilities.narrationHints: They go quiet and slightly unfocused for a breath, the way someone does listening for a sound they think they heard. Then they tell you the thing.
abilities.description: Perceive your tradition's own domain directly — not by inference or instrument, but because you are attuned to it and it is simply there.
abilities.notFor: Anything outside your tradition's domain; acting on what you find; certainty at range where the world is noisy.

bounds.text: ⛔ YOUR TRADITION'S DOMAIN ONLY — a Mason attunes to material, never to a want
tells you what IS, never what to do about it
a noisy environment for your domain drowns it — a crowd for feeling, a foundry for sound
⚠️ it costs a breath of standing still, and people notice

abilities.plainly: An investigate/survive action that reveals information. Its strength is rated 3 out of 10. Ranks: rank 2 adds depth and history, rank 3 adds a whole place at once.

sectFlavour.mason: STONE-READ — what a material truly is, whether it is sound, and the stresses it has taken.
sectFlavour.somatic: BODY-READ — condition, hidden hurt, exhaustion, and what the hands do when the face does not.
sectFlavour.churnfolk: CHAOS-SENSE — where and roughly when a thing will come apart, and the loose thread.
sectFlavour.rootkin: LIFESENSE — living things through wall and dark; number, vigour, what is merely holding on.
sectFlavour.horizon: WAY-SENSE — bearing, distance, and the true cost of a route before you walk it.
sectFlavour.hourkeeper: HOUR-SENSE — how long since, how long until, and the age of a place or a lie.
sectFlavour.lattice: ORDER-SENSE — a system's rules and load-bearing points, and the design it is part of.
sectFlavour.enginewright: MECHANISM-SENSE — how a working functions on sight, and where it will fail.
sectFlavour.numinous: NUMEN-SENSE — where meaning runs dense, where the world is thin, and where something presses.
sectFlavour.blazeborn: LIGHTSENSE — where light falls and what it hides; residual heat, the age of a scorch.
sectFlavour.ashwarden: DEATHSENSE — what is dying, how, and roughly how long.
sectFlavour.abyssal: APPETITE-SENSE — the want beneath the asking, including the one they refuse to admit.
sectFlavour.unmaker: FAULT-SENSE — where a thing is under stress, and the one piece whose failure brings the rest.
sectFlavour.marcher: READ THE FIGHT — a foe's tell a beat early, who is committed, where the line fails first.
sectFlavour.stillhold: READ THE ROOM — the true temperature under the words, and who is about to move.
sectFlavour.seraphic: THE WEIGHING LOOK — the moral weight a person carries, and what it cost others.
sectFlavour.veilwright: SEE THE MADE THING — what is constructed against what is found; the falsecraft in the room.
sectFlavour.threnodist: THE TRUE FEELING — what is actually felt, not what is shown.
sectFlavour.cogitant: COLD-READ — thought and intent from micro-signal; not magic, mastery.
sectFlavour.figurist: PATTERN-SENSE — that these particulars are an instance of something, and of what.
sectFlavour.verist: THE PLAIN SEEING — illusion, disguise and staging come off it; what was added and what moved.
sectFlavour.wright: THE SOUND JOINT — what was made well, what was made fast, and what is about to let go.
sectFlavour.syllogist: THE STATED GROUND — the premise a person is standing on without having said it.

tree.name: Near Sense
tree.grants: ⛔ PERCEIVE YOUR DOMAIN IN WHAT IS PRESENT — the thing in front of you, plainly, without instrument or inference.
tree.cannot: What is present and close. Your domain only.

tree.name: Depth and History
tree.grants: ⚠️ ADDS TIME AND HIDDENNESS. Read what your domain has BEEN — the stresses it took, the repair, the day it nearly broke — and what is deliberately hidden from you within it.
tree.cannot: You must be near enough to attend properly; a busy environment for your domain drowns it.

tree.name: Whole Field
tree.grants: ⛔ ADDS SCALE. A whole place at once, as one continuous fabric — and where it is torn.
tree.cannot: One place at a time, and holding it is a minute of standing still.
